svg.title: Unify - OCR, Layout Detection & Reading Order

g.text: Unify - OCR, Layout Detection & Reading Order
Coarse layout detection (11 DocLayNet classes) is performed
upstream by Prepare-Doc and provided in DocumentMetadata.json.
Unify performs full reading order + table structure analysis only.
This diagram shows the downstream Unify project's workflow.
It is provided here to illustrate how Prepare-Doc outputs
Unify internals are NOT part of the Prepare-Doc codebase.
